ASKPASS_DIALOG_MESSAGE:
It seems the MITMPROXY certificate is not installed.

Without this certificate, FIT Web cannot intercept HTTPS traffic and therefore cannot works.

To install it, administrator privileges are required: you will be asked for the root password (possibly more than once).
This operation is performed only the first time.

No internet

FIT cannot be run without an internet connection.

Try:
- Checking the network cables, modem, and router
- Reconnecting to Wi-Fi

BOOSTSTRAP_MACOS_SCREEN_RECORDING_PERMIS:
FIT does not have permission for screen recording and system audio capture.

Without this authorization, FIT cannot record the acquisition video and therefore cannot run.

To resolve the issue, authorize FIT in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording.

It would seem that the fit-screen-recoder binary is missing or is not accessible.

Without fit-screen-recoder, FIT cannot complete screen recording and therefore cannot run correctly.
